facts: Post: dashboard must be built into, or embedded and viewable within, each client's own GoHighLevel sub-account; no separate website or login; a link to a separate platform does not qualify.
Post: one table with one row per email campaign: name, send date, recipients, delivered, open rate, click rate, unsubscribes where available.
Post: reporting for email marketing, paid Meta ads, organic posting, Google Analytics and sales pipelines; Meta reports mirror GHL's Meta Ads report layout (screenshots to come).
Post: replicable by their team across sub-accounts without code, documented setup, automatic updates, client data separation, date filters, validation against source reports.
No client name evidenced in two reviews (Darren appears in one review only), so no personalization.
